blocks.text: FOR METRO USE ONLY METRO Contract #: Date: Exhibit A Pricing The pricing model for this contract is as follows: Scope of Services One Stop will retrieve Metro mail at the time and place designated by Metro. The mail will then be by One Stop to the US Postal regulations in order for Metto to receive the maximum discount. One Stop agrees to rettieve and process all pieces regardless of whether address is typed or handwritten. The mail will then be deposited by One Stop with the US Service the following morning for delivery. One Stop will supply the postal rates for Metro to place on out going mail, These rates are subject to change, but only upon a price change by the US Postal Service. Metro Postal will be responsible for metering the mail with the next business day date imprinted on the mail pieces. This method will allow delivery times equal to US Postal Service First Class service (3-5 days). This method. will also allow Metro to account track actual by agency. One stop will bill Metro a service charge of .04 cents per piece. This charge is firm for the duration of the contract.
